response.answer: Recent studies highlight interdisciplinary resilience assessment in rural agro-industries, focusing on Spanish wineries. Key trends include MNAR sensitivity analysis, ethnography-informed DAGs, and spatial data integration for agroecological trials. Supply-chain corrections are crucial for resilience.
